text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...A dessert themed around the school... Something's missing, but what?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Father? Hallo?

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hallo, mein Schatz. I heard about the
contest from an associate at
Spring
Confectioners. How's it going?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's all going to plan. I promise to
achieve stunning results and
make the
event a success.

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Flash, you know of
Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte, yes?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Yes. It's a well-known cake based on
the Black Forest region in 
Baden-Württemberg, isn't it? Made with
the local specialty, cherry
liquor.

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
It's said that the cream stands
for fallen snow, chocolate chips for the
fallen leaves, and the cherries themselves
make for a large portion of the region's
livelihood.

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
Although I am not from
Baden-Württemberg, I get a real sense of
the
Black Forest when I eat it.

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
The cold snow, the dense foliage, the
cherry orchards... I'm moved to
think that
they've been there, loved and respected,
for centuries.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Father...

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the Black Forest, Tracen Academy
doesn't have centuries of history or any
local produce,
so it might be hard to reach the same
level of depth with your cake...

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
But I am sure there is plenty one could be
moved by at the academy, because it's a
wonderful place where wonderful students
like you
come together.

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
If I were you,
I would start by looking for
what that is.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So, I think that rather than using a
simple theme like racing or the
grounds, we need
to think of something that will speak to
the heart.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And that's what I'd like to ask you all
about. What moves you about
Tracen
Academy? Or rather, what is the
academy's charm?

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...!
This is rather unexpected... I didn't
think we'd get such different
answers.
Hm...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I think we should narrow it down to one
theme. We'll either have to
choose one, or
find a common thread that ties them all
together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
First, we could interview each team
member and narrow down our
choices
based on the results. Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have a suggestion. There is a more
efficient method than doing
individual
interviews.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: GOOD MOOORNING!

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"7:50 a.m.—Bakushin O stands at the
school gates and greets arriving
students
for thirty minutes."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is my morning routine!
Everything
starts with a greeting! That
goes without
saying for an honor student like myself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's lunchtime,
everyone! I'll collect all your
Japanese homework! Step
riiight up and
leave it in my hands!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I nearly forgot to turn it in! Thanks,
Bakushin, you're a lifesaver.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I know, right? I'm so dependable!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Perfect greetings, Bakushin-shin! Be
dependable, Bakushin-shin!
Study hard,
Bakushin-shin! Run like the wind,
Bakushin-shiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes tonight's Bakushin
aerobics! See you tomorrow!
Good niiight!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Seeing is believing. Now I understand. She
truly is leading by
example.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have a much better understanding of
what school life means to her
this way than
I would've gotten through an interview.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A deeper understanding will help us when
it comes to deciding on our motif. I
suggest that we continue with this method,
following a day in the life of each of our
helpers.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yawn... I'm hella tired...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are you guys here? Oh yeah,
it's that thing today, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nom, nom... This burger is bussin'! And the weather is giving me life! Today just hits different! ...WAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Shut up. Why're you shouting?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I forgot my assignment for fifth
period! Oh
snap!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, that's adorbs! I want it! Ah, I
don't have enough money.

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Yo Jordan, did you chip a nail just now?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? OMG you're right! My nails are the
secret to my success... so
let's hit up the
nail care aisle.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Has a strong interest in beauty. Is
particularly proactive about nail
care. Also
has an impressive number of friends." I
see.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm the last one,
right? I'll do my best! Um,
hope I can help!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Flower! Sorry, could you help me
with the assignment we got
yesterday? I
don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sure! Of course!
If you're okay with me
doing it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I always bring my lunch with me. When the
weather's nice, I eat out in
the courtyard!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And actually... I've brought lunch for you
both today too, so would
you like to eat
with me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've been borrowing a little plot here to
grow strawberries! I'm hoping
we can all
enjoy them together when spring comes
around!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I usually stop by to check on them on the
way to training. Am I doing
this right? I
hope it's actually helping.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Hehe. The leaves look nice and
healthy. Do you manage
this plot all by
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mostly, yes. But sometimes, like just
before winter, it's too hard to do
it on my
own. I wish I didn't have to ask for
help...
